stats.basic_same_with_unlimited: Complimentary accounts only · {{count}} paid accounts currently unlimited
stats.basic_split_with_unlimited: Complimentary Space {{space}} · User {{user}} · {{count}} paid accounts currently unlimited
stats.premium_empty: No Premium value returned · This does not represent Custom Agent credits

actions.check_instructions_help: Only checks whether the default Notion Agent has a personal-instructions page bound; instruction text is never read or stored.

cleanup.subtitle: Choose the account type to remove. You will be asked to confirm before deletion.
cleanup.auth_invalid_help: Remove logins and workspaces that returned a confirmed 401
cleanup.exhausted_help: Recheck and remove limited-trial workspaces with no quota
cleanup.no_workspace_help: Recheck live and remove only accounts that still have no accessible workspace

api.settings_description: Manage API access, proxy, feature switches, and runtime history.
api.version_help: Use this to verify Railway has deployed the latest build
api.version_check_failed: Could not fetch the latest image version
api.api_key_load_failed: Could not load the API Key
api.request_history_help: View the latest 100 model, account, latency, and error records
api.register_history_help: View bulk registration history, results, and retries
api.persist_help: Changes save immediately and persist across restarts.
api.prompt_tools_help: Control client prompts, personal instructions, and external tools. Changes apply to new requests.
api.client_prompt_help: On: keep the client's system prompt. Off: ignore it while still sending ordinary messages.
api.notion_personal_help: On: the current account's default Agent loads its saved Notion personal instructions. This can be enabled with the client prompt.
api.tool_bridge_help: On: enable Claude Code, Tools, and function calling. Off: send requests as ordinary chat.
api.tool_choice_policy_help: Follow Client preserves each request; other options override tool_choice for every request.
api.import_check_help: When enabled, Add Account can import all accounts or only accounts with personal instructions. Only the result is stored, never the instruction text.
api.ask_help: When enabled, requests default to ASK mode (answers only, no page edits). Append -ask to a model name for a per-request override.
api.data_backup_help: Back up all accounts and the feature settings on this page. Restoring replaces the current accounts and takes effect immediately.
api.data_backup_warning: The backup contains account login data and any credentials embedded in the proxy URL. Store it securely. API keys, admin passwords, request history, and token statistics are excluded.
api.restore_confirm:
Restoring deletes all current accounts and replaces them with the accounts in this backup. Feature settings will also be restored. Request history and token statistics are kept.

Continue?

add.title: Bulk Add Notion Accounts
add.subtitle: One token_v2 per line; import multiple accounts at once
add.intro: Paste one token_v2 per line. Five accounts are validated concurrently by default, and single-token import still works.
add.how_to: How to get: Open notion.so → F12 → Application → Cookies → Copy token_v2 value
add.check_help: Only the binding is checked; instruction text is never read or stored. Import All keeps probe failures, while Configured Only skips them.
add.import_all_help: Check and label accounts without filtering
add.duplicate_existing: The account for this token already exists and was not imported again
add.missing_skipped: Default Agent personal instructions are not configured; account skipped
add.check_failed_kept: · instruction check failed; kept by Import All

register.title: Bulk Register Accounts
register.credentials_placeholder:
One account per line, separated by four hyphens:
email----password----client_id----refresh_token

example@hotmail.com----P@ssw0rd----abcd-1234----0.AYI...
register.proxy_desc_fallback_global: Supports socks5 / socks5h / http / https. Proxy entered here takes precedence; leave blank to fallback to global proxy (enabled).
register.proxy_desc_fallback_direct: Supports socks5 / socks5h / http / https. Proxy entered here takes precedence; leave blank for direct connection (no global proxy configured).
register.modal_close_note: Closing the modal will not cancel submitted tasks. You can view them in "History Tasks".
register.paste_credentials_warning: Please paste at least one line of credentials
register.proxy_url_invalid: Proxy URL must start with http:// or socks5:// etc.
